parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $json.body.model || 'qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-base' }}",
  "prompt": "Create a blog post about: {{ $json.body.chatInput }}

Format Requirements:
- First line: Clear, engaging title (plain text, no # symbols)
- Leave one blank line after title
- Use ## for main section headings
- Use ### for subsections
- Write 800-1200 words
- Include relevant code examples if applicable (use ```language syntax)
- Include relevant examples and explanations
- Write in markdown format
- Make it SEO-friendly with natural keyword usage
- For images, use markdown format: ![alt text](image-url)

Important: Start directly with the title on line 1, no preamble.",
  "stream": false,
  "options": {
    "temperature": 0.7,
    "top_p": 0.9
  }
}

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "post_url": "{{ $json.link }}",
  "post_id": "{{ $json.id }}",
  "title": "{{ $json.title.rendered }}",
  "message": "Blog post created successfully in draft mode",
  "edit_url": "https://shivaprogramming.com/blog/wp-admin/post.php?post={{ $json.id }}&action=edit"
}
